facts.summary: Interim data show ORR below primary endpoint threshold; trial continues · Phase 2 pivotal · envafolimab in sarcoma (UPS/MFS) · not yet approved
facts.indication: refractory sarcoma subtypes UPS and MFS

evidence.summary: The objective response rate (ORR) is currently 11% by investigator review and the confirmed ORR by blinded independent central review (BICR) is currently 5.5% (four patients).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: An additional five objective responses confirmed by central review are needed to achieve our goal in the 82 patient cohort of single agent envafolimab treatment.
evidence.safety: Envafolimab has been well tolerated without the development of a single drug-related serious adverse event of grade 3 or higher.
evidence.program_discontinued: recommended the ENVASARC Phase 2 pivotal trial continue as planned.
